effects: The signer's ENS voting power, equal to their whole current ENS balance and following future balance changes, moves to `delegatee` (ERC20Votes._delegate sets _delegates[signer] = delegatee and moves votes from the old delegate).
The signer's previous delegate loses the signer's voting power (the single delegate slot is replaced).
The signer's delegation nonce is used up (`require(nonce == _useNonce(signer))`), so the signature works once.
The signature can be submitted by anyone until `expiry` (`require(block.timestamp <= expiry)`). No ENS tokens move.
formats.shown: "Delegate ENS voting power" with the delegatee address, the nonce and the expiry, all shown raw (expiry as a bare Unix timestamp).

findings.title: Delegation expiry is shown as a raw Unix timestamp instead of a date.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json field {"path":"expiry","label":"Expiry","format":"raw"}; case 0 screen shows Expiry "1798761600". ERC20Votes.delegateBySig: require(block.timestamp <= expiry, ...), so it is a seconds timestamp.

findings.title: Delegatee is shown with the raw format instead of addressName.
findings.fix: Use "format": "addressName" with "params": {"types": ["eoa","contract"], "sources": ["local","ens"]} so wallets can resolve the delegate's name.

findings.title: There is no interpolatedIntent, so the intent line does not say who gets the voting power.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json has intent "Delegate ENS voting power" and no interpolatedIntent; the delegatee is the key party of ERC20Votes.delegateBySig.
findings.fix: Add "interpolatedIntent": "Delegate ENS voting power to {delegatee} until {expiry}".

findings.title: A zero-address delegatee means removing the delegation, and the screen does not say so.
findings.evidence: ERC20Votes._delegate moves votes to delegates(delegator) = address(0); _moveVotingPower skips the zero address, so the signer's votes stop counting. The descriptor shows the address raw.
findings.fix: Optionally use an addressName/senderAddress-style label or a note so 0x000…0 reads as "no delegate (remove)".

findings.title: The raw nonce is a technical value that adds noise for the signer.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json field {"path":"nonce","label":"Nonce","format":"raw"}; it only enforces one-time use via _useNonce.
findings.fix: Optionally mark nonce as "visible": "never" or keep it at the end as is.
